0022600229.text: The Timberwolves (8-3, 4-1 at home, fourth straight win) host the Mavericks (7-4, 5-2 on the road-free side at 5-2 at home, three straight wins) in Minnesota's 12th game of the season, with both teams having played 11 games so far. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery, averaging 33.3 points in 33.7 minutes this season) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and is a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 124-94 win in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
